ns2:section.sectionText: Financial System & Monetary Economics: This course focuses on the money side of macroeconomics. Close to two thirds of the class deals with financial markets, instruments traded on financial markets, and financial intermediaries. The remaining class time is devoted to central bank behavior, exchange rate, and monetary policies. ********RESTRICTED TO ECON-LAS MAJORS. At this time, we do not plan on lifting the restriction.
